lead_raw_text:
The structure of K2Bi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms (K4Bi2) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 12 K neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while K centers have 10 geometric neighbors (2 Bi and 8 K). Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between K-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Bi-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
